parsed.explanation: The dossier documents state-tolerated organised targeting: arrests on gender-presentation grounds under an aggressively enforced criminalisation regime (rated among the world's most aggressive prosecutors), a 2021 case where two trans women received the five-year statutory maximum for wearing women's clothing with no proof of acts, a 2022 security-force sweep of arbitrary arrests and beatings, and documented appearance-based convictions. Recourse fails on every rung: an LGBTQ organisation was shuttered by police, few lawyers take such cases, prisons are described as 'hell', and the main documented 'successes' are appellate acquittals and flight into exile. Society is hostile (beatings of gay and trans people in public described as common; national backlash to a public coming-out). Severity reaches level 4-5 (imprisonment, custodial violence) at high frequency with the state as perpetrator; no protective machinery operates. This sits at the severe-risk band, near 0.15: recurring coercive targeting with failed recourse, short of the near-certain execution profiles at 0.05 but matching the 0.15 anchors.
